Current SGR was omitted from frameRestoreAnsi. Track CSI m in the splitter. Ghostty serializes 16-color SGR as 38;5;n/48;5;n; compactSnapshotSgr maps those back to 31;44;1 so snapshotAnsi matches the oracle byte test.
